Concluding international licensing and manufacturing agreements

Extending a product range through partners abroad.

The objective

Extend the product portfolio of a Bengaluru fitness and performance venture through arrangements with European partners.

Shyam’s contribution

As a director of and investor in the venture, Shyam negotiated and concluded licensing and manufacturing agreements with European partners.

The outcome

Licensing and manufacturing agreements with European partners were concluded. The source does not describe subsequent commercial results.

Source: Shyam Sundar Pani’s account.

The experience this brings

Negotiating cross-border licensing and manufacturing arrangements, and connecting an Indian business with overseas partners.

Related services

  • Develop workable agreements
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
